book.timemod.astronomer.page1: For years I have watched the sky. But it is not always today's sky. Sometimes stars shine that died long ago – or ones that are yet to be born.
book.timemod.astronomer.page2: Deep below, where the Warden sleeps, someone tapped into time itself. The ruins still hum. Four shards, they say, wake its hunger.
book.timemod.astronomer.page3: The Clockmaker built himself a workshop without a door. He never wanted to be disturbed again. Yet his work still ticks – bring it a clockwork, and it will answer.
book.timemod.astronomer.page4: There are gates: rings of chronite that turn until the year gives way. I saw forests that do not exist yet, cities of glass – and lizards as tall as towers.
book.timemod.astronomer.page5: If you read this: wind your watch. And never trust a time that is too quiet.
book.timemod.astronomer.title: The Astronomer's Notes
commands.timemod.chrono.rewind.nothing: Nothing to rewind – use /chrono record on first
death.attack.timemod.old_age.player: %1$s died of old age while %2$s watched
gui.timemod.workbench.hint: Insert a time tool to install modules.
item.timemod.blank_module.desc: Base board for filters and amplifiers.
item.timemod.brake_spring.desc: A creature or projectile runs at half time for 10 s.
item.timemod.chronite_plate.desc: Pressed chronite around a netherite core – base of Chrono armor.
item.timemod.chrono_debug_wand.hint: Right-click: create zone · Sneak: change factor
item.timemod.chrono_knife.desc: Thrown in stopped time they hang in the air – until time moves on.
item.timemod.clockwork_core.desc: The ticking heart of the Clockmaker. It still beats.
item.timemod.duration_module.desc: +50% duration – for the spool: further back.
item.timemod.filter_environment.desc: Snow, ice, fire, leaves and weathering.
item.timemod.filter_machines.desc: Furnaces, hoppers, spawners and machines from other mods.
item.timemod.filter_players.desc: The tool affects other players (never you).
item.timemod.filter_projectiles.desc: Arrows, fireballs, TNT and falling blocks.
item.timemod.filter_redstone.desc: Redstone, pistons, scheduled block ticks – and built blocks when rewinding.
item.timemod.filter_villagers.desc: The tool only affects villagers and traders.
item.timemod.growth_hourglass.desc: One block (plant, sapling, furnace, machine) runs 4× as fast for 30 s.
item.timemod.moment_lens.desc: Freezes a moment: a creature, a projectile in flight or a block – for 3 s.
item.timemod.phage_heart.desc: It devoured countless seconds – and gives them back only grudgingly.
item.timemod.pocket_watch.desc: Shows time, day, moon phase and the flow of time where you stand.
item.timemod.recall_watch.desc: Jumps 5 seconds back: your path in reverse, your health as it was.
item.timemod.rewind_spool.desc: Rewinds everything within 16 blocks up to 10 seconds.
item.timemod.slow_pendulum.desc: A zone with 0.5× or 0.25× time (radius 6, 30 s).
item.timemod.stasis_watch.desc: Stops time within 12 blocks. Only you can move.
item.timemod.strength_module.desc: Unlocks stronger factors (up to 10× or 0.05×) – for the spool: faster.
item.timemod.time_core_fragment.desc: A shard from the heart of time. Four of them wake something in the Chrono Ruins.
message.timemod.altar.clockmaker: The altar rests. A clockwork might wake it …
message.timemod.altar.phage: Four empty sockets. Time core fragments are missing …
message.timemod.rewind.nothing: There is nothing to rewind here yet
message.timemod.wind_up: The spring is slack – sneak + hold right-click to wind it up
message.timemod.workbench.busy: Someone is already working at this workbench.
